$comment: How GitHub deploys to n8n. projectId / folderId: where every workflow goes (from the folder's address in n8n: /projects/<projectId>/folders/<folderId>/workflows). workflows.<key>.active: publish (turn on) the workflow after deploying it. credentials: the n8n credential each type uses, found by name in that project (or set id once you know it). See docs/n8n-deploy.md.
